entities.summary: Khachatur Bezirjyan is an Armenian physicist, political figure, statesman, candidate of biological sciences. Bezirjyan has been serving as Vice-Rector for Supplementary and Continuing Education at Public Administration Academy of the Republic of Armenia since 2016.
